tools.name: health
tools.title: Service health
tools.description: Liveness probe plus database connectivity check and API version. Call once at startup to confirm the API and dataset are reachable.

tools.name: meta
tools.title: Discovery metadata
tools.description: Row counts, live sample identifiers (order numbers, emails, RMAs, tracking numbers), every enum value and the business-rule constants. This is the recommended bootstrap call for an agent. Fetch first so you can use real identifiers in later calls instead of guessing.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.title: List / search orders
tools.description: Paginated order list with filters. Use `email` when a customer contacts support without an order number. Primary lookup when the customer gives an email address rather than an order number.

status.description: Query parameter. Comma-separated list of order statuses.

order_number.description: Query parameter. Exact order number, e.g. BK-10042.

q.description: Query parameter. Fuzzy search across order number and customer email.

placed_after.description: Query parameter. ISO date lower bound on placed_at.

placed_before.description: Query parameter. ISO date upper bound on placed_at.

tools.name: place_order
tools.title: Place a new order
tools.description: Creates an order for an existing customer (or a brand-new one) and charges it. Books are matched by book_id, isbn or partial title; prices come from the catalog, so never send prices. Shipping: ground is free over $35.00 otherwise $4.99, expedited $12.99, overnight $24.99. Tax is 8.25% of the discounted subtotal. Stock is decremented, a charge transaction is written, and the response includes the full order plus a pricing breakdown. Use when a caller wants to buy or re-order a title. Load GET /api/public/v1/inventory first to confirm the exact ISBN and stock, then place the order. If a title is short on stock you get 409 conflict — read back the shortfall and retry with allow_backorder: true only after the customer agrees.

customer_name.description: Full name, only used when creating a new customer.

create_customer_if_missing.description: Create the customer when the email is unknown. Requires an email in `customer`.

isbn.description: Preferred way to identify the book.

title.description: Partial title match, used when no ISBN is known.

shipping_address.description: Optional override: line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country. Defaults to the customer's address on file.

use_store_credit.description: Apply the customer's available store credit to this order.

allow_backorder.description: Place the order as `backordered` instead of failing when stock is short.

notes.description: Internal note recorded on the order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Full order with customer, line items, shipments, returns, refunds and transactions embedded. The single richest call for answering 'where is my order?'.

id.description: Path segment. Order UUID or human order number (e.g. BK-10042). Both are accepted everywhere.

tools.name: get_order_items
tools.title: List order line items
tools.description: Line items with the joined book record (format matters for return eligibility). Use the returned order_item_id values when creating a partial return.

id.description: Path segment. Order UUID or human order number (e.g. BK-10042). Both are accepted everywhere.

tools.name: get_order_shipments
tools.title: List shipments for an order
tools.description: All shipments for the order, each with its full tracking event history. Answer delivery-timing questions and detect stalled tracking.

id.description: Path segment. Order UUID or human order number (e.g. BK-10042). Both are accepted everywhere.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancels an order and voids the authorization. Only allowed while the status is processing or backordered. Use for 'cancel my order'. If it returns 409, offer a return instead.

id.description: Path segment. Order UUID or human order number (e.g. BK-10042). Both are accepted everywhere.

tools.name: reship_order
tools.title: Create a replacement shipment
tools.description: Generates a new shipment and tracking number. Allowed when the order is lost_in_transit or shipped. Use for lost-in-transit packages after confirming tracking is stalled.

id.description: Path segment. Order UUID or human order number (e.g. BK-10042). Both are accepted everywhere.

tools.name: return_eligibility
tools.title: Check return eligibility
tools.description: Deterministic eligibility check. Standard window is 30 days from delivery; damaged or wrong-item claims get 90 days and waive the $4.99 label fee. Ebooks are non-returnable. Always call this before creating a return so you can explain the outcome to the customer.

id.description: Path segment. Order UUID or human order number (e.g. BK-10042). Both are accepted everywhere.

tools.name: list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: Paginated returns with their items and parent order. Check whether a return already exists before creating a duplicate.

order_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by order UUID.

customer_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by customer UUID.

tools.name: create_return
tools.title: Create a return (RMA)
tools.description: Creates an RMA with a prepaid label and computes the expected refund. Rejects with 409 when the order is not eligible unless `override_eligibility` is true. Call after eligibility passes. `items` is optional — omit it to return every line on the order, or match lines by order_item_id, isbn or title. Set initiate_refund to open the refund in the same call.

isbn.description: Match the line by ISBN instead of UUID.

title.description: Match the line by (partial) book title.

quantity.description: Units returned; defaults to the full line quantity.

items.description: Line items to return. Omit to return every item on the order.

initiate_refund.description: Open a refund with the RMA: `pending_return` parks the money until the book is received, `immediate` settles it now (loyalty / goodwill).

actor.description: Who is acting, recorded on the refund timeline.

override_eligibility.description: Supervisor override that bypasses the eligibility gate.

tools.name: get_return
tools.title: Get a return
tools.description: Fetch a return by RMA number (RMA-12345) or UUID. Answer 'what is the status of my return?'.

rma.description: Path segment. RMA number or UUID.

tools.name: receive_return
tools.title: Mark a return received
tools.description: Moves the return to `received`, optionally issuing the refund immediately. Warehouse-side action; set auto_refund to close the loop in one call.

rma.description: Path segment. RMA number or UUID.

tools.name: cancel_return
tools.title: Cancel a return
tools.description: Cancels an open RMA. Fails with 409 once the return is refunded. Use when the customer decides to keep the item.

rma.description: Path segment. RMA number or UUID.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.title: List refunds
tools.description: Paginated refunds with their parent order. Confirm whether money already went back before promising a new refund.

order_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by order UUID or order number.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.title: Issue a refund
tools.description: Issues a full or partial refund, records the matching ledger transaction, credits store credit when requested and flips the order to `refunded` once fully covered. Over-refunding is rejected. Use for goodwill refunds and post-return settlements.

amount_cents.description: Defaults to the full remaining refundable amount.

return_id.description: Link the refund to an existing return.

status.description: Initial status. Default `succeeded` (money moves now). Use `pending_return` to promise a refund once the book is received.

note.description: Free-text note stored on the refund timeline.

tools.name: get_refund
tools.title: Get a refund
tools.description: Fetch a refund by refund number (RF-12345) or UUID. Give the customer the exact refund amount and timing.

id.description: Path segment. Refund number or UUID.

tools.name: update_refund
tools.title: Update a refund status
tools.description: Moves a refund to any status. Settling (`succeeded`) writes the ledger transaction, applies store credit and flips the order to refunded once fully covered; cancelling or failing a settled refund writes a reversal. Every change appends to the refund timeline (`events`). Use to release a `pending_return` refund early for a loyal customer, or to cancel a refund the customer no longer wants.

id.description: Path segment. Refund number or UUID.

amount_cents.description: Adjust the amount (only before it settles).

note.description: Why the decision was made — shown on the timeline.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.title: List ledger transactions
tools.description: Immutable money ledger: charges, refunds and voids. Reconcile what the customer was actually charged.

order_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by order UUID.

customer_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by customer UUID.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List / search customers
tools.description: Search customers by email, fuzzy name/email query or loyalty tier. Identity resolution before touching order data.

q.description: Query parameter. Fuzzy name or email search.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Fetch by UUID or email (URL-encoded), including saved addresses and store credit. Check store credit balance before offering it as a refund method.

id.description: Path segment. Customer UUID or email address.

tools.name: get_customer_orders
tools.title: List a customer's orders
tools.description: Order history for a customer, newest first. Accepts UUID or email. Use when the customer says 'my last order' without a number.

id.description: Path segment. Customer UUID or email.

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.title: Track a shipment
tools.description: Fetch a shipment by tracking number or UUID, with its events and parent order. Direct tracking lookup when the customer pastes a tracking number.

tracking.description: Path segment. Tracking number or shipment UUID.

tools.name: get_shipment_events
tools.title: Tracking event history
tools.description: Chronological scan events for a shipment. Detect a stalled package: no new scan for 7+ days means offer a reship.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.title: Full inventory snapshot
tools.description: Returns the entire book catalog in one call — every title with author, format, category, price and current stock — plus per-author rollups and totals in `meta`. No search or pagination. Call this once at the start of a conversation to load the whole catalog into context; then answer stock, author and price questions without further lookups.

tools.name: list_books
tools.title: Search the catalog
tools.description: Search books by title, author or ISBN with category, format and stock filters. Recommend replacements or confirm stock before promising a reship.

q.description: Query parameter. Search title, author or ISBN.

in_stock.description: Query parameter. Only items with stock > 0.

tools.name: get_book
tools.title: Get a book
tools.description: Fetch a book by UUID or ISBN-13. Confirm format — ebooks cannot be returned.

id.description: Path segment. Book UUID or ISBN.

tools.name: list_policies
tools.title: List policies
tools.description: Shipping, returns, refunds, privacy and account policies in full text. Ground policy answers in this text instead of improvising.

q.description: Query parameter. Full-text-ish search across title and body.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.title: Get one policy
tools.description: Fetch a single policy document by slug, e.g. `returns`. Quote the exact clause back to the customer.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.title: Search FAQs
tools.description: Curated question/answer pairs for common support topics. First stop for general questions that need no account data.

q.description: Query parameter. Search question and answer text.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.title: Search past support tickets
tools.description: Paginated, filterable ticket history with customer, order and full event history embedded — the record of every previous support interaction. Search this before acting: check for an existing open ticket and read what was already promised to the customer.

email.description: Query parameter. Filter by customer email.

customer_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by customer UUID.

order_id.description: Query parameter. Filter by order UUID.

q.description: Query parameter. Free-text search over subject and ticket number.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.title: Create a support ticket
tools.description: Opens a ticket, linking the customer by email and optionally an order. Escalation path when you cannot resolve the request with the other endpoints.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Change status, priority or record a resolution. Accepts TCK number or UUID. Close the ticket once the customer confirms the issue is resolved.

id.description: Path segment. Ticket number or UUID.

tools.name: password_reset
tools.title: Send a password reset link
tools.description: Simulates sending a reset email. Always returns success so account existence is never leaked. Standard answer for 'I can't log in'.

tools.name: address_change
tools.title: Change a shipping address
tools.description: Updates the shipping address while the order is still pending or processing. Use before the order ships; afterwards offer a return or intercept instead.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.title: Get one support ticket
tools.description: Full ticket with customer, order and the complete event history (messages, notes, resolutions). Read the ticket history before replying so you do not repeat or contradict a previous agent.

id.description: Path segment. Ticket number (TCK-#####) or UUID.

tools.name: log_agent_trace
tools.title: Log a completed agent conversation
tools.description: Records one CX-agent conversation (every turn plus every tool call) so Bookly staff can audit what the agent did. Call this at the end of every conversation. Formatting contract: each message carries `role`, an optional bold `speaker`, an ISO-8601 `occurred_at` timestamp, markdown `content`, and — for tool turns — `tool_name`, `tool_input` and `tool_output`. Anything structured goes in `metadata`. Mandatory after every customer interaction. Include a plain-language `summary` explaining the reasoning behind any refund, return or escalation.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences on what you did and why.

customer_email.description: Customer email — makes the trace queryable by customer.

order_id.description: Related order UUID or BK-##### number.

ticket_id.description: Related ticket UUID or TCK-##### number.

agent_name.description: Display name of the agent, default 'Bookly CX Agent'.

intent_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence in the detected intent. Required on every trace.

resolution_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence that the outcome actually resolved the request. Required on every trace.

status.description: Use in_progress if you will append more turns later.

escalated.description: True when handed to a human.

metadata.description: Any extra structured context for staff.

role.description: Turn type. Use `tool` for API calls and `note` for internal reasoning never shown to the customer.

speaker.description: Display name rendered in bold, e.g. 'Customer' or 'Ada (CX Agent)'.

content.description: Markdown message text, verbatim for customer turns.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the turn.

duration_ms.description: How long the turn/tool call took.

tool_name.description: Tool or operation id for `tool` turns, e.g. create_refund.

intent_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence in the understood intent AT THIS TURN. Required on every agent/tool turn; rendered as a pie chart.

resolution_confidence.description: 0-1 confidence that this turn moves toward/achieves resolution. Required on every agent/tool turn; rendered as a pie chart.

metadata.description: Structured extras shown next to the turn (policy id, rule that fired…).

messages.description: Ordered conversation turns. Log every customer message, every agent reply, every tool call and any internal reasoning notes.

tools.name: list_agent_traces
tools.title: Search past agent conversations
tools.description: Paginated, searchable history of every logged CX-agent conversation, with all messages and tool calls embedded. Check this before answering: if you already promised something to this customer, honour it instead of re-deciding.

order_id.description: Query parameter. Order UUID or BK-##### number.

tag.description: Query parameter. Single tag the trace must carry.

q.description: Query parameter. Free-text search over subject, summary, transcript and trace number.

started_after.description: Query parameter. ISO date lower bound.

started_before.description: Query parameter. ISO date upper bound.

tools.name: get_agent_trace
tools.title: Get one agent conversation
tools.description: Full trace with customer, order, ticket and the ordered message list including tool inputs/outputs. Pull the exact wording of a previous promise before continuing a follow-up conversation.

id.description: Path segment. Trace number (TRC-######) or UUID.

tools.name: append_agent_trace_messages
tools.title: Append turns to a trace
tools.description: Adds more messages to an existing trace, in order, and recomputes counts, duration and the transcript. Use for long-running conversations you logged with status in_progress.

id.description: Path segment. Trace number or UUID.

tools.name: update_agent_trace
tools.title: Update a trace
tools.description: Revise the summary, outcome, sentiment, tags or status of an already-logged conversation. Close out an in_progress trace or correct the recorded outcome.

id.description: Path segment. Trace number or UUID.
